name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-01-29, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.80 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
